shortBulletSummary: Escalated US-Iran strikes caused Bitcoin to correct below $79,000.
August's robust US jobs data fueled Federal Reserve rate hike fears, pressuring crypto markets.
Despite recent pullbacks, the Crypto Fear & Greed Index shows 'Greed' at 60.
While some altcoins dipped with macro trends, others like Sei, Sui, and LayerZero showed gains.
